parsed.post: New best! Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 improved val_bpb from 1.0357 to 1.0274. This suggests the deeper model benefits from more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget. Next: testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 with this smaller batch to see if we can further stabilize the 1.027 result.
parsed.description: Stacking batch size reduction (262144) with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to increase optimization steps and stabilize training for the DEPTH=8 model.
